Master Mobile Plan (2026) > Updates (coverage_matrix.csv XLSX Tab 'Updates', 2.49 grab-bag section) > 'Auto CC Update 1' - 'Install lower version with Daily auto-update preset'. This sets the app's Auto Update Frequency custom property to Daily via HQ's General Settings > Custom Properties (edit_commcare_profile), which is exactly the mechanism hq_client.py's set_custom_properties() posts to. The property key/value below are NOT a guessed placeholder - both were confirmed directly in the commcare-android source (read-only reference, never modified by this repo): app/src/org/commcare/preferences/MainConfigurablePreferences.java line 32 (`public final static String AUTO_UPDATE_FREQUENCY = "cc-autoup-freq";`) and app/src/org/commcare/preferences/PrefValues.java line 11 (`public final static String FREQUENCY_DAILY = "freq-daily";`), and cross-checked against live-looking app fixtures that set this exact key/value in a real profile.ccpr, e.g. app/unit-tests/resources/commcare-apps/update_tests/base_app/profile.ccpr line 33: `<property key="cc-autoup-freq" value="freq-daily"/>`. app/src/org/commcare/update/UpdateHelper.java's getAutoUpdateFrequency()/isAutoUpdateOn()/getAutoUpdatePeriodicity() read this same key back off the device to decide whether/how often to auto-check for a CommCare (APK) update - so setting it via HQ's custom_properties is the correct HQ-side lever for this row, not a device-local Settings-menu toggle (there IS also an on-device 'Auto Update Frequency' preference at app/res/xml/main_preferences.xml line 8-9, but this row is about the HQ-provisioned default a freshly-installed app ships with, which is the custom_properties path).

The 'install lower version' half of this row is out of scope here - it's the framework's existing APK-provisioning step (scripts/download_apk.py --tag <older-release>), not an HQ action, mirroring coverage_matrix.csv's Install-tab 'Setup 1' row ('handled by scripts/download_apk.py - no dedicated flow needed'). UPDATE (2026-08-24), per direct user-supplied app link (https://www.commcarehq.org/a/qateam/apps/view/8a04cdf1b9474ee2b090b1d7896b1bd7/) + screen recording: app_id switched to '[Master] Basic Tests NS Copy' (app_registry.py's BASIC_TESTS_NS_COPY entry), matching every other flow on this tab now - see hq_setup/updates_2_49/setup_02_commcare_version_plus_one.json's header for the full citation on why a dedicated app. Supersedes the 2026-08-21 'Basic Tests by proximity' guess for this row.
